desc: Prove that an MST preserves the minimax path value \(f(x,y)\), and formulate the corresponding Kruskal reconstruction tree.
Derive the bottom-up matching recurrence: combine child surpluses, match opposite types at the current weight, and determine the residual surplus passed upward.
Design an \(O((N+M)\log M)\) construction using DSU or a Kruskal reconstruction tree, including treatment of equal edge weights.
Specify how to initialize multiplicities from the sequences \(A\) and \(B\), compute each node’s contribution, and use sufficiently wide integer arithmetic.
Provide an iterative implementation plan that avoids recursion-depth issues and outputs the accumulated minimum sum.
